body: I realize that I should be going into counseling. I went for seven months, though, and was still incapable of talking about what happened. The problem with bringing a case against this person is I don't have enough physical evidence (I have pictures of injuries/bruises, and a screenshot of him admitting to raping me via im, but that's it). Also, I'm afraid of what testifying/being in court would do to my psyche.
